subject.title: feat: add disableBoundaryAwareCache compat option for prefix-matching prompt cache providers

question: Should OpenClaw permanently expose `compat.disableBoundaryAwareCache` and enable it automatically for DeepSeek, or keep the behavior as an internal DeepSeek-specific provider policy without a public override?
rationale: The live proof establishes the regression and effectiveness of the message layout, but repository policy sets a high bar for new config surfaces and automation cannot choose the long-term provider compatibility contract.

options.title: Sponsor the narrow compat surface
options.body: Accept the DeepSeek-only default plus explicit opt-out, then require suffix sanitization and a clean rebase before merge.

options.title: Make it provider-internal
options.body: Remove the public configuration field and apply the proven layout only through DeepSeek detection, reducing permanent config surface at the cost of operator override flexibility.

options.title: Consolidate with the alternate PR
options.body: Pause this branch and choose the narrower surviving implementation from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/94945 only if it gains equivalent live proof and complete transport coverage.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the narrow compat surface
recommendation.body: Accept the DeepSeek-only default plus explicit opt-out, then require suffix sanitization and a clean rebase before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history connects this person most directly to provider compatibility defaults and the model/config contract being chosen.
